name: Isolette Verus Verification (semantic tier)
description: cargo-verus verify over every contract-bearing isolette crate (report-derived) plus the system-level proof crate: the generated Verus contracts must PROVE against the implemented behavior, and the normalized verification results are goldened — the verified COUNT is pinned, not just errors==0. The verus toolchain is hashed in the same term, before the invocations (measure-then-use).
